items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-11-10
items.q: They had Witt Lebowski. You heard of Witt Lebowski?

ctx.x: I mean, fans maybe six or seven feet in diameter. And that was one thing. But they had a good band at the Liberty. They had Witt Lebowski. You heard of Witt Lebowski?
I've heard him on records, huh?
